body:
Chief: correction to my previous message -- two command names in it came out EMPTY.
I wrote them in backticks inside a double-quoted shell string, so the shell executed
them instead of sending them. My error, and a fitting one for today: a step that
reported success while silently dropping its payload.

The sentence should have read:

  Bare "scalafmtCheck" is the COMPILE config. Your new file is a TEST source, so the
  check you ran could not see it. Use "scalafmtCheckAll" instead -- it covers every
  config and every platform.

Everything else in that message stands: D1 041872e is accepted on correctness,
1121 tests green across 13 modules on a merged tree off current main, GATE_EXIT=0,
and the only thing holding it is formatting on

  acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquireprobe/ConstructionProbeSuite.scala

Format it, push, send me the SHA, and I merge. No re-gating needed.
